context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview DB has minimal data so absolute perf numbers are optimistic. Real production validation requires load testing with thousands of call_logs and 10+ telecallers. Reusable perf regression tests at /app/backend/tests/test_reports_performance.py with a 2s budget per endpoint. Existing reports_old.py backup can be removed by main agent.
rca of the issue: Original slow reports were caused by an N+1 query pattern: the endpoint iterated telecallers and issued ~10 sequential Mongo queries per user (count_documents / find_one). Fix: (1) rewrote all reports endpoints (telecallers, hourly, detailed-calls, daily-tracking-sheet, verified-call-stats, dashboard/stats) to use single MongoDB aggregation pipelines with $match+$group per resource, then merge results in Python via lookup maps; (2) run independent aggregations concurrently with asyncio.gather; (3) added compound indexes on (user_id, created_at), (assigned_to, updated_at/created_at/status), (user_id, timestamp), (user_id, date). Verified: endpoint latency dropped to ~100-150ms and frontend tabs no longer stick on loading spinner.
